decision: No new forecast candidate promoted. Preserve the existing qualified point and risk models.
production_changes: Build both API and optional refresh-worker images during deployment.
Preflight all configured serving qualifications before a full-refresh fit; preserve prior model bundles on mismatch.
limitations: 2025 has already been explored; neither the screen nor its bootstrap interval is an untouched external-provider comparison.
Observed regular-season stat rows retain zero/negative outcomes, but inactive roster weeks are not reconstructed.
Fixed pregame reference cohorts prevent candidate rank selection from changing the comparison population.
The 2026 fit-vintage diagnostic contains only weeks 1-3 and changes P50 alone; P10/P90 remain fitted through 2024.
Current-player examples include present-day roster and availability heuristics; they do not validate historical overlays.
These research artifacts do not publish or deploy fitted models.

current_role_walk_forward.cohort: Observed regular-season player-stat rows, including zero/negative scores; inactive roster weeks not reconstructed.
